# What ci.yml's test matrix watches, as git pathspecs -- an exclusion rather
# than a list, because the matrix asks "does the shipped binary still run this
# JavaScript", which everything except prose can change.
#
# Read by that workflow's `changes` job and by `just check-workflow-gates`.
# `:(glob)` makes `**/` match any number of directories, none included, so
# `**/*.md` is every Markdown file in the tree, `README.md` among them. Nothing
# the matrix runs reads one: prettier is the only step that does, and the
# `format` job runs it on every pull request whatever moved.
.
:(glob,exclude)docs/**
:(glob,exclude)**/*.md
:(exclude)LICENSE
